title: Diagnostic Service in Outpatient Care Facilities — Minimum Requirements
sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DIAGNOSTIC SERVICE IN OUTPATIENT CARE FACILITIES
notes: The section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 31) — those common requirements are covered by the all-institutions module and are not duplicated here. The section ends where the 'MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- CONVENTIONAL RADIOLOGY' heading begins on the same page; conventional radiology requirements belong to that separate module.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DIAGNOSTIC SERVICE IN OUTPATIENT CARE FACILITIES
items.requirement: Outpatient Care facilities may provide specific range of diagnostic imaging services within the premises, such as ultrasound, conventional radiography (general radiology), Computer Tomography (CT), or Magnetic Resonance Images (MRI)

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DIAGNOSTIC SERVICE IN OUTPATIENT CARE FACILITIES
items.requirement: The facility shall meet design and building requirements for the specific diagnostic imaging service

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DIAGNOSTIC SERVICE IN OUTPATIENT CARE FACILITIES
items.requirement: Sharing reception, waiting area and support areas for diagnostic imaging services (e.g. toilets, medical records / files area, etc.) are permitted
items.alternatives: Reception, waiting area and support areas (e.g. toilets, medical records / files area) may be shared with the diagnostic imaging services rather than provided separately

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS- DIAGNOSTIC SERVICE IN OUTPATIENT CARE FACILITIES
items.requirement: If the facility is providing any diagnostic imaging service where contrast media may be used; the facility must provide easy access for parking and emergency ambulance pickup area within the premises
items.applicability: where the facility provides any diagnostic imaging service in which contrast media may be used
items.conditional: Applies only if the facility is providing any diagnostic imaging service where contrast media may be used
